create_optimizer: create a kfac_jax optimizer with adaptive damping, learning rate schedules, and curvature estimation
run_optimizer_step: run a single optimizer step with params, state, rng, and batch to update model parameters
init_optimizer_state: initialize the optimizer state with params, rng, and example batch for tracing
build_adaptive_damping: build an optimizer with Levenberg-Marquardt adaptive damping that adjusts damping based on reduction ratio
test_curvature_estimation: test the kfac_jax curvature estimator with fisher or ggn estimation modes and EMA updates
